But before you pick a fund, avoid these 3 mistakes that cost first-time investors years of wealth:

𝐌𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝟏: Waiting for the "Right Time" There is no perfect time to invest. Markets will always feel either "too high" or "too uncertain." Every day you wait is a day compounding is not working for you. Time IN the market always beats TIMING the market.

𝐌𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝟐: Investing Without a Goal Picking a mutual fund without a goal is like booking a flight without a destination. Are you investing for a home? Retirement? Your child's education? Your goal decides your fund, your tenure, and your SIP amount. Start with WHY.

𝐌𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝟑: Stopping SIPs When Markets Fall This is the most expensive mistake. When markets dip, your SIP buys MORE units at LOWER prices that is rupee cost averaging working in your favour. Stopping your SIP during a fall means selling the opportunity short.

What if you could start building wealth with just Rs. 500 a month?

That is exactly what a SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) allows you to do.
A SIP lets you invest a small, fixed amount in mutual funds every month, automatically. No need to time the market. No need for a large lump sum. Just consistency and time.

Here is why SIP works so powerfully:
•	Rupee Cost Averaging - You buy more units when markets are low and fewer when markets are high, automatically reducing your average cost over time.
•	Power of Compounding - Your returns earn returns. The longer you stay invested, the faster your wealth grows.
•	Discipline Without Effort - SIP automates your investment so you never miss a month.
•	Flexibility - Start with Rs. 500/month. Increase anytime as your income grows.
Whether your goal is buying your dream home, funding your child's education, or building a retirement corpus - SIP is the simplest, most disciplined way to get there.
